EC1: Subject has documented typical atrial flutter.
EC2: Subject has any history of successful or unsuccessful treatment of AF with class I [OR] or III antiarrhythmic [OR] or sotalol with the intention to prevent an AF recurrence. Patients pretreated with above AAD at maximum 48 hours with the intention to convert an AF episode are allowed.
EC3: Subject had any previous left atrial ablation.
EC4: Subject had any previous cardiac surgery, e.g. prosthetic valves.
EC5: Subject has permanent pacemaker [OR] or defibrillator implant.
EC6: Subject has 2° type II [OR], 3° degree AV-block [OR] or left [OR]/right bundle branch block pattern.
EC8: Subject has history of previous myocardial infarction [OR] or percutaneous intervention during the last three months.
EC10: Subject has chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with detected pulmonary hypertension [OR] or any other evidence of significant lung disease.
EC11: Subject has any contraindication [AND] for oral anticoagulation.
EC12: Subject has any history of previous transient ischemic attack [OR] or stroke.
EC13: Subject has known intra-cardiac thrombus formation.
EC14: Subject has any significant congenital heart defect corrected or not ([NOT] except for patent foramen ovale that is allowed).
EC15: Subject has evidence of congestive heart failure [AND] (NYHA class II [OR], III [OR] or IV) in sinus rhythm.
EC17: Subject has abnormal long [OR] or short QT interval [OR], signs of Brugada syndrome [OR], known inheriting ion channel disease on the family [OR], arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia.
EC20: Subject has myxoma. Exclusion criteria based on laboratory abnormalities
EC21: Subject has thrombocytosis [OR] (platelet count > 600,000 / µl) or thrombocytopenia [AND] (platelet count <100,000 / µl).
EC22: Subject has any untreated [OR] or uncontrolled hyperthyroidism [OR] or hypothyroidism.
EC23: Subject has renal dysfunction [AND] with glomerular filtration rate < 60 ml / min.
EC24: Subject has known cryoglobulinaemia. General exclusion criteria
EC25: Subject has a reversible causes for AF like hyperthyroidism [OR] and alcoholism.
EC26: Subject is a pregnant woman or woman of childbearing potential not on adequate birth control: only woman with a highly effective method of contraception [oral contraception or intra-uterine device] (who must have a negative pregnancy test within 1 week of the start of the therapy) or sterile woman can be enrolled.
EC28: Subject has an active systemic infection.
EC29: Subject is employed by Medtronic or by the department of any of the investigators or is a close relative of any of the investigators.
EC30: Subject is unwilling or unable to comply fully with study procedures and follow-up due to any disease condition, which can raise doubt about compliance and influencing the study outcome especially any kind of cancer, severe bleeding in history or a suspected pro-coagulant state.
EC31: Legal incapacity or evidence that a subject cannot understand the purpose and risks of the study or inability to comply fully with study procedures and follow up.
EC32: Subject has a life expectancy of = 1 year.
EC33: Subject is currently enrolled or planning to participate in a potentially confounding drug or device trial during the course of this study. Co-enrollment in concurrent trials is only allowed when documented pre-approval is obtained from the Medtronic study manager.
